attributes.comment:
In response to the Committee's request for general insights about consumer engagement with Southwest Airlines' website pages dedicated to Passenger Rights...
Consumers are going to our “Help Center” and “Customer Commitment” pages – some pages (a lot) more so than others. We receive around 5.1M (total) interactions with pages related to different “Passenger Rights” over the most-recent 12-month period - which is the equivalent of 3% of enplaned PAX (5.1M interactions/170.7M enplaned PAX for the 12-month research range) or DOT Ratio = approximately 3,000 interactions per 100,000 enplaned PAX. The Top 5 Passenger Rights categories visited during the most-recent 12-month period are: Baggage Policies, Travel Funds, Disability Accommodations, Customer Commitments, and Customer Service Plan.
